objective: How long a twelve-step journey takes from queued to verdict
input: Ten executions of the same unedited test
expected: Ten passing runs, with their durations recorded
detail: queued to verdict: median 2061ms (min 2052ms, p95 2069ms, max 2069ms, n=10); in the browser: median 1075ms (min 963ms, p95 1127ms, max 1127ms, n=10); platform overhead about 986ms; about 90ms per step
